selection.source: official Vision2Code test pool, restricted to released local image assets
selection.stratification: proportional stratification by source dataset (15 source datasets); same quotas in both sets, covering all six domains
selection.isolation: disjoint task IDs and exact image SHA256 across the 100/100 sets
selection.note: The local release has no source training images. Therefore this is a custom split within the official evaluation pool; report as benchmark-internal memory generalization, not as the official Vision2Code leaderboard score.

near_duplicate_policy: Exclude prior pilot IDs and exact image hashes; MP-DocVQA also excludes document IDs across and within sets. Semantic/template near duplicates are not certified.
test_policy: Static evaluation: bank is frozen; no test feedback or answer is written to memory.
